output.summary: A herbaceous perennial native from Mexico through Central America to Colombia and Ecuador, tree dahlia has hollow, cane-like, four-sided stems and large leaves. Its nodding flowerheads are typically lavender or mauvish-pink.
output.edibilityNote: Petals can be eaten in salads or soups; Q'eqchi' people in San Pedro Carchá, Guatemala, use the leaves as a dietary supplement.
